Office**Job Description**

**Position Summary**
--------------------


At Thermo Fisher Scientific, our mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Within our Functional Service Provider (FSP) organization, the **GPS Functional Project Manager, Process \& Operations** plays a critical role in supporting the successful delivery of Global Patient Safety (GPS) services by driving operational excellence, leading strategic initiatives, and continuously improving business processes.


This role combines project management, operational leadership, process optimization, and stakeholder engagement to ensure consistent execution of business priorities across global teams. The successful candidate will partner with internal functional leaders, client stakeholders, and cross\-functional teams to implement scalable solutions, improve operational performance, and support high\-quality service delivery in a regulated environment.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Project Management**

* Lead and manage strategic functional and operational initiatives from planning through implementation.
* Develop comprehensive project plans, timelines, milestones, resource plans, risk registers, and success metrics.
* Coordinate cross\-functional project teams to ensure timely delivery of agreed objectives.
* Facilitate governance meetings, project workshops, and stakeholder reviews.
* Identify project risks, issues, dependencies, and mitigation strategies while escalating critical decisions when appropriate.
* Prepare executive\-level project updates, dashboards, status reports, and presentations.
* Ensure projects align with Thermo Fisher Scientific operational standards, client expectations, and business objectives.

### **Process \& Operational Excellence**

* Evaluate, document, and optimize operational workflows across Global Patient Safety functions.
* Lead process mapping, gap analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance efficiency and quality.
* Develop standardized operating procedures, process documentation, templates, and best practices.
* Define and monitor operational performance indicators (KPIs) and process effectiveness metrics.
* Support implementation of sustainable process improvements through change management activities.
* Promote a culture of operational excellence, standardization, and continuous improvement.

### **Knowledge Management \& Business Operations**

* Maintain operational knowledge repositories, SharePoint sites, collaboration platforms, and business documentation.
* Ensure onboarding materials, training resources, governance documentation, and functional communications remain current and accessible.
* Coordinate inputs from subject matter experts to maintain accurate operational content.
* Support business planning activities, governance forums, leadership meetings, and operational communications.
* Track recurring operational deliverables and ensure timely completion of business commitments.
* Champion effective utilization of project portfolio management and collaboration tools.

### **Stakeholder Engagement**

* Build collaborative relationships with internal functional leaders, delivery teams, quality, technology, and client stakeholders.
* Facilitate effective communication across global, cross\-functional teams.
* Translate business requirements into practical project plans and operational solutions.
* Provide leadership in coordinating complex initiatives across multiple functions.
* Influence stakeholders through strong communication, organization, and problem\-solving skills.

**Qualifications**
------------------

### **Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Healthcare, Business, Public Health, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 5 years of experience within pharmaceutical, biotechnology, CRO, healthcare, or life sciences organizations.
* Minimum 3 years of project management, PMO, business operations, process excellence, or consulting experience.
* Demonstrated success leading cross\-functional projects within complex global organizations.
* Experience with business process mapping, process redesign, and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and presentation skills.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, and project management tools.
* Knowledge of project portfolio management systems (e.g., Planisware, Smartsheet, MS Project, or similar).
* PMP certification or equivalent project management certification preferred.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting Global Patient Safety, Pharmacovigilance, Drug Safety, Clinical Development, Regulatory Affairs, Medical Affairs, or other GxP\-regulated functions.
* Experience within Functional Service Provider (FSP) or Contract Research Organization (CRO) environments.
* Experience supporting global client partnerships and matrix organizations.
* Lean Six Sigma or continuous improvement certification is advantageous.
* Experience with organizational change management or business transformation initiatives.

**Core Competencies**
---------------------

* Project \& Program Management
* Operational Excellence
* Business Process Improvement
* Continuous Improvement
* Stakeholder \& Client Management
* Change Management
* Risk \& Issue Management
* Governance \& Business Operations
* Strategic Planning \& Execution
* Communication \& Influencing
* Cross\-functional Leadership
* Quality \& Compliance
* Analytical Problem Solving

**What We Offer**
-----------------


At Thermo Fisher Scientific, you'll join a global organization committed to advancing science and improving patient outcomes. We provide opportunities to work alongside industry\-leading experts, support world\-class pharmaceutical and biotechnology partners, and contribute to meaningful projects that impact global healthcare. Our culture promotes innovation, collaboration, professional development, and continuous learning while empowering employees to grow their careers in an inclusive and purpose\-driven environment.

### **Brenntag, the global market leader in the distribution of chemicals and ingredients, supports customers and partners with high\-quality technical, commercial, and logistical solutions.**

### **To strengthen our Pharma Business Unit, we are looking for a** **Regulatory Affairs Specialist** **with a technical background in pharmaceutical or related industries, particularly with experience in regulatory documentation and compliance.**

### **As a key member of the Pharma team, you will support the EMEA division on all regulatory, quality, compliance, legal, and product stewardship topics related to the supply of a large portfolio of raw materials into the pharmaceutical industry. Your primary responsibility is to provide accurate, timely, and audit‑ready documentation to pharmaceutical customers and to support regulatory deliverables for bespoke product projects.**

### **The role is primarily office‑based, with occasional travel required for supplier meetings, customer visits, audits, or internal workshops.**

### **You will collaborate closely with commercial, supply chain, QHSE, and supplier partners to ensure that all materials supplied meet applicable pharmaceutical regulations and industry standards.**

### **Key Responsibilities**

### **Customer Documentation \& Regulatory Support:**

* ### **Prepare, review, and issue** **technical and regulatory documentation** **required by pharmaceutical customers, including:**


	+ ### **Quality \& Technical Agreements**
	+ ### **Supply Chain Statements**
	+ ### **Regulatory Questionnaires**
	+ ### **Compliance Statements (e.g., TSE/BSE, GMO, allergens, nitrosamines, residual solvents, elemental impurities)**
* ### **Ensure all documentation is accurate, consistent and aligned with applicable frameworks (i.e. relevant pharmacopoeia, IPEC Guidelines, EU GDP and GMP guidelines.**

### **Information Gathering \& Supplier Engagement**

* ### **Source regulatory, quality, and technical information internally and from suppliers to fulfil customer requests.**
* ### **Evaluate supplier documentation for completeness, compliance, and suitability for pharmaceutical use.**

### **Customer Request Management**

* ### **Log, track, and report customer documentation requests using defined KPIs.**
* ### **Support continuous improvement by identifying trends, gaps, and opportunities to streamline documentation processes.**

### **Support for Customer Value Added Service Projects**

* ### **Lead and manage regulatory deliverables for customer\-specific projects.**
* ### **Coordinate regulatory assessments, supplier data collection, and compliance documentation for new product introductions or customised specifications.**
* ### **Support change control evaluations and customer notifications.**

### **Regulatory Compliance \& Standards Implementation**

* ### **Work with QHSE and supply chain teams to ensure compliance with applicable standards (IPEC GMP/GDP, EXCiPACT, GDP, and other regulatory frameworks).**
* ### **Support implementation of new regulatory requirements and internal standards across the business unit.**

### **Cross\-Functional Collaboration**

* ### **Partner with commercial and value\-added services teams to provide regulatory expertise for customer projects and commercial initiatives.**
* ### **Contribute to global Pharma Regulatory team projects, harmonisation efforts, and continuous improvement activities.**

### **Training \& Knowledge Sharing**

* ### **Deliver training to commercial, supply chain, and internal teams on regulatory topics relevant to supply of materials into the pharmaceutical industry.**
* ### **Act as a subject matter expert for documentation, compliance, and regulatory expectations.**

### **Additional Responsibilities**

* ### **Perform any other tasks within capability to support the commercial, regulatory, and compliance success of the Pharma business unit.**

### **Qualifications \& Experience**

* ### **Degree in a life science discipline (chemistry, biochemistry, pharmaceutical sciences) or equivalent relevant experience.**
* ### **Strong knowledge of pharmaceutical industry requirements for APIs, excipients, biopharma materials, and traditional pharma raw materials.**
* ### **Understanding of European National Competent Authority requirements for distribution of APIs, excipients, and raw materials.**

### **Skills \& Competencies**

* ### **Fluent in English and Italian (spoken and written).**
* ### **Strong written communication skills with the ability to produce clear, accurate, and compliant documentation.**
* ### **Excellent collaboration skills with the ability to work proactively across all levels and functions.**
* ### **Ability to interpret regulations, resolve compliance issues, and respond to complex regulatory queries.**
* ### **High attention to detail and strong organisational skills.**
* ### **Willingness to undertake occasional travel for customer meetings, supplier visits, audits, or internal workshops.**

**DESCRIPTION**

Reinvent how the world's largest robotics network gets deployed.  

Amazon is seeking a Senior Manager for our Robotics Delivery, Packaging \& Innovation to define and lead the Design for Deployment (DfD) technical deep\-dive, and associated implementation strategy, across our global robotics fulfillment network. This is a founding, build\-it\-from\-scratch role: you will define what "deployable" means for every robotics technology Amazon ships, and your decisions will shape how thousands of implementations happen across six continents.  

  

Amazon's culture encourages an entrepreneurial approach and expects engineers and managers alike to take a high level of ownership in solving complex problems in a fast\-paced environment.  

  

The role could be based in Vercelli or alternatively in London or Luxembourg with \~60% travel across Europe and internationally for design reviews and field validation activities.  

  

The applicable collective agreement for this role is CBA for Executives of the Industrial Sector (CCNL per i Dirigenti di aziende del Settore Industriale). The position is classified at level Dirigente.  

  

The minimum gross annual base salary for this position is listed below. The base salary listed corresponds to working on a full\-time basis. For part\-time hours, the salary will be pro\-rated.  

  

Amazon reserves the right to offer a higher salary and/or level, depending on the candidate's skills, competencies, and experience. Amazon's package may include a sign on payment. In addition, the candidate may be eligible to participate in a restricted stock unit scheme operated independently by Amazon.com Inc. in USA.

In addition to statutory benefits, and those applicable to the relevant CBA, company supplementary benefits may apply subject to further terms.  

  

Italy \- 90,100 EUR gross annually.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

This is a hands\-on, boots\-on\-the\-ground technical role. In the role you will:  

  

* Serve as the organization's DfD technical authority, overview engineering drawings, mechatronic designs, and controls architectures, to embed quantified deployment requirements into engineering design, providing a single consolidated deployment voice and force multiplying deployment teams across multiple technology programs.
* Drive technically complex DfD programs: determining feasibility of infrastructure builds at scale, identifying when deployment issues stem from technical design decisions, and driving engineering to design to a defined deployment bar (mechanical, electrical, controls, layout, system integration and mechatronic domains).
* Advise VPs and the broader Robotics leadership on strategy, governance mechanisms and trade\-offs, drive clarity where the problem itself may be undefined, optimize cross\-organizational structures that enable teams to deliver independently.
* Coach deployment teams to engage in engineering design reviews, design decisions, and feed field learnings back to product teams systematically. You'll mentor deployment engineers and TiPMs, sharing DfD best practices and technical deep\-dive methods and helping managers guide career growth.
* Define and own the end\-to\-end DfD strategy across all technology programs, ensuring every program has a quantified deployment bar (installation duration, workforce management, safety risk, cost per unit install).
* Force multiply deployment teams by creating, optimizing, and driving adoption of DfD mechanisms that enable teams to operate independently and at scale.
* Decompose complex deployment design problems into straightforward infrastructure solutions; define DfD Core Tenets and quantified requirements that engineering designs to across all solutions.
* Establish and evangelize the principle that deployment data is influence currency: creating systems and expectations for teams to document and quantify deployment pain caused by design decisions, replacing anecdotal feedback with systematic, data\-driven design influence.
* Remediate critical and/or endemic deployment design problems; make trade\-offs between business opportunity, resources, and sustainability with a long\-term perspective.
* Identify endemic deployment problems, such as recurring modularity constraints, cable management challenges, or commissioning inefficiencies, diagnosing them and drive engineering to eliminate them at the source rather than compensating in the field.
* Drive measurable DfD outcomes and metrics, such as reduction in deployment duration, cost per unit, first\-time installation success rate.

  

A day in the life  

As a Sr. Manager, you will be the person that engineers and design owners come to for the deployment verdict. Your work will have global impact across multiple organizational goals and program\-related metrics.  

  

* You'll operate with complete independence in an area where business and infrastructure build strategy may not yet be defined.
* You will spend real time on the floor, next to the machines and the teams installing them, which is exactly where this role earns its credibility and its impact.
* You'll partner with other Robotics teams to validate design improvements and quantify realized savings against targets.
* You'll drive the cultural shift across the organization: coaching teams to stop absorbing complexity and start preventing it, building confidence in deployment engineers to challenge design decisions with data, and establishing new norms where field intelligence flows systematically back to product teams.

  

No two days will be the same in our fast\-paced environment, offering opportunities for strategic impact as part of a collaborative, high\-performing team.  

  

About the team  

Robotics Delivery \& Packaging Innovation is a diverse and multi\-talented team with a proven track record of overcoming challenging technical problems to deliver Amazon’s leading\-edge robotics technologies in its fulfillment, transportation, and delivery network across the world. Our high\-performing team blends engineering know\-how, problem solving, curiosity, innovation, leadership, and effective communication to deliver positive results for our customers.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree or above in engineering or equivalent STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics) field
* Experience mentoring or training the engineering community on complex technical issues
* Experience in a technical program management in the hardware/mechatronic development, deployment engineering domain or equivalent
* Technical depth in mechanical, electrical, controls, and mechatronic designs

description:
**About Radian Arc.**  

Radian Arc provides an infrastructure\-as\-a\-service (IaaS) platform for running cloud gaming, artificial intelligence and machine learning applications inside telecommunication carrier networks. Our teams across the USA, Australia, Central Europe, Malaysia, Singapore and Japan offer telecom operators a GPU\-based edge computing platform without the need for capital expenditure, facilitating low latency and improved economics for value\-added services and the monetization of 5G investments.


**What impact you will have**



Mission: Install, validate, operate, and maintain regional and core GPU cloud deployments across datacenter environments**.**



This role owns the practical deployment and operational readiness of the platform stack in the field. It bridges infrastructure engineering, datacenter operations, networking, host systems, storage, and platform operations. The engineer is responsible for taking a validated architecture and BOM and turning it into a working production environment, including physical deployment coordination, rack and cabling validation, switch and host bring\-up, firmware and BIOS validation, operating\-system installation, GPU and DPU validation, storage integration, platform stack installation, acceptance testing, and operational handover.



The role is intentionally hands\-on and cross\-domain. It is not a pure datacenter technician role, and it is not a pure platform engineering role. It is the person who can work in a datacenter, understand cabling and optics, debug host and network issues, validate GPU servers, support platform installation, and coordinate with engineering when problems arise.



The role is especially important as the platform evolves from regional deployments toward HGX\-based GPU systems, east\-west fabrics, and core AI infrastructure. This profile is focused on actual installation, commissioning, maintenance, and operational readiness.


**What you'll do**


### **Datacenter deployment and commissioning**


* Coordinate physical deployment activities with datacenter providers, integrators, logistics teams, and internal engineering.
* Validate rack layouts, elevations, power feeds, airflow assumptions, cable paths, and labeling before installation.
* Support rack\-and\-stack activities for GPU nodes, CPU nodes, storage nodes, switches, firewalls, routers, serial/OOB equipment, PDUs, and supporting infrastructure.
* Validate fibre and copper cabling against the deployment design, including OOB, north\-south, east\-west, storage, and management networks.
* Validate optics, transceivers, link speeds, breakout cables, port mappings, and redundancy assumptions.
* Maintain accurate as\-built documentation, including rack elevations, cable maps, port maps, serial numbers, asset records, IP allocations, and change records.

### **Host and hardware bring\-up**


* Bring up GPU servers, platform servers, storage nodes, and supporting infrastructure.
* Validate BIOS, BMC, firmware, NIC, DPU, GPU, NVMe, RAID/HBA, and platform firmware versions.
* Configure and validate BMC access using Redfish/IPMI and OOB management networks.
* Validate GPU visibility, PCIe topology, NUMA layout, thermals, power behavior, and hardware health.
* Run hardware acceptance tests, burn\-in tests, GPU stress tests, network tests, and storage validation before handover.
* Troubleshoot hardware issues across servers, GPUs, DPUs, NICs, optics, cables, disks, memory, firmware, and BIOS.

### **Network deployment support**


* Support deployment and validation of OOB, north\-south, storage, and east\-west networking.
* Work with networking engineering to apply and validate switch configurations.
* Validate BGP, ECMP, VLAN/VRF segmentation, EVPN/VXLAN where applicable, OVS/OVN integration, and routing reachability.
* Validate VyOS routers, OOB firewalls, transit routers, Citrix NetScaler/WAF, and customer connectivity.
* Support RoCE/RDMA fabric validation for distributed AI workloads where applicable.
* Troubleshoot practical network issues such as link flaps, optics issues, incorrect polarity, MTU mismatches, route leaks, VLAN errors, packet loss, PFC/ECN issues, and fabric congestion.
* Support integration with NVIDIA Cumulus / Spectrum\-X environments, and assist with Cisco or SONiC\-based alternatives if those become part of the roadmap.

### **Platform stack installation and validation**


* Support installation and validation of the platform stack across regional and core deployments.
* Install and validate host operating systems, kernel versions, NVIDIA drivers, Mellanox/NVIDIA OFED or inbox drivers, CUDA compatibility, Docker/containerd, KVM/QEMU, and platform agents.
* Support CloudStack\-based deployments and Kubernetes/KubeVirt\-based deployments.
* Validate GPU passthrough, SR\-IOV, BlueField NIC/DPU behavior, VM networking, and container networking.
* Support Kubernetes node registration, GPU Operator validation, CSI validation, CNI validation, and node lifecycle workflows.
* Support storage integration with StorPool, Weka, local NVMe, or other supported storage platforms.
* Execute acceptance tests and produce deployment readiness reports.

### **Operational maintenance and Day\-2 support**


* Perform controlled maintenance activities such as firmware upgrades, switch upgrades, host OS updates, GPU driver updates, BIOS changes, and hardware replacements.
* Support incident response for infrastructure issues affecting GPU nodes, hosts, networking, storage, or platform components.
* Perform root\-cause analysis for deployment and operational failures.
* Maintain runbooks for installation, validation, upgrade, rollback, troubleshooting, and handover.
* Work with engineering to turn repeated operational issues into automation, better validation, or platform improvements.
* Participate in on\-call or escalation rotations for regional and core environments where appropriate.

### **Platform observability and validation**


* Ensure telemetry is correctly configured for hosts, GPUs, DPUs, switches, storage, OOB devices, and platform components.
* Validate Zabbix, Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, DCGM/NVML, NVIDIA NetQ or equivalent telemetry sources.
* Confirm that deployment health checks, hardware alerts, performance dashboards, and operational alarms work before production handover.
* Support performance baseline testing for GPU, network, storage, and host layers.
* Assist with NCP\-related validation and benchmarking.

### **Cross\-team coordination**


* Work closely with the Senior Director of Infrastructure Operations.
* Work closely with Staff Network, Staff Storage, Sr Hardware/Infrastructure, Sr Platform, Sr Fleet Automation, Observability, Product Engineering, Sales Engineering, and Service Delivery roles.
* Provide field feedback into reference architectures, BOMs, rack layouts, cabling standards, deployment playbooks, and validation procedures.
* Coordinate with external vendors including datacenter providers, systems integrators, server vendors, storage vendors, NVIDIA, and networking vendors.
* Act as the practical field escalation point when architecture, BOM, datacenter conditions, and platform implementation do not align.

**Technical Stack**
-------------------


### **Hardware and datacenter**


* GPU servers: L40S, RTX 6000 Pro, H200, B200/B300\-class systems, HGX systems, and future NVL72\-style rack\-scale systems.
* CPU/platform servers.
* Storage nodes and JBODs.
* PDUs, BMCs, serial/OOB, firewalls, routers, switches.
* Rack layouts, power feeds, airflow, cold/hot aisle containment, cabling, optics.
* DTC/DLC cooling.

### **Host and systems**


* Ubuntu Linux.
* Linux networking.
* BIOS/BMC/firmware lifecycle.
* Redfish, IPMI.
* NVIDIA drivers, CUDA, DCGM/NVML.
* Mellanox/NVIDIA NICs, BlueField DPUs.
* KVM/QEMU, VFIO, PCI passthrough.
* Docker/containerd.

### **Networking**


* NVIDIA Spectrum/Cumulus.
* VyOS.
* OVS/OVN.
* BGP, ECMP, VLAN, VRF, EVPN/VXLAN.
* RoCE/RDMA.
* SR\-IOV.
* Citrix NetScaler / WAF.
* OOB and break\-glass access.

### **Platform**


* CloudStack.
* Kubernetes.
* KubeVirt.
* NVIDIA GPU Operator.
* CSI/CNI integrations.
* StorPool, Weka, local NVMe.
* Terraform, Ansible, Bash, Python.

### **Observability**


* Zabbix.
* Prometheus.
* Grafana.
* Loki.
* DCGM Exporter.
* NVIDIA NetQ or equivalent.
* Logs, metrics, hardware health, and deployment validation dashboards.


**What you'll need**


* Strong hands\-on experience deploying and maintaining datacenter infrastructure.
* Experience with GPU, HPC, AI cloud, private cloud, or high\-density compute environments, including both air\-cooled and liquid\-cooled (nice to have) deployments.
* Familiarity with NVL72\-style rack\-scale architecture, NVLink/NVSwitch domains, in\-rack networking, high\-density power delivery, and OEM/NVIDIA validation requirements.
* Comfortable working across physical infrastructure, Linux hosts, networking, storage, and platform software.
* Experience bringing up servers from bare metal through production readiness.
* Experience with rack layouts, cabling, optics, transceivers, power, OOB management, and datacenter handover.
* Strong Linux troubleshooting skills.
* Practical networking knowledge across VLANs, VRFs, BGP, ECMP, OVS/OVN, and routing.
* Experience with GPU servers, NVIDIA drivers, firmware, PCIe topology, and hardware validation..
* Strong documentation discipline and ability to produce accurate as\-built records and runbooks.
* Ability to validate practical datacenter readiness for current and next\-generation AI infrastructure, including power density, cooling model, rack depth/width, floor loading, containment, serviceability, and maintenance access.


Personal qualities:

Quince partners with world\-class manufacturers across the globe and serves millions of customers. With strong investor backing and a focus on sustainable growth, we are a company that is rapidly scaling while maintaining a commitment to quality, simplicity, and radical price transparency.

At Quince, you will be part of a high\-performing team that is redefining what quality, value, and sustainability mean in modern retail. We are a destination for builders, innovators, and operators to come together and challenge the status quo. Our collective ambition is bold. We are creating an entirely new category and customer experience – one that democratizes luxury and provides high quality products at radically low prices. That mission demands a world\-class team committed to excellence.



If you are motivated by impact, growth, and purpose, you will find a strong sense of belonging at Quince.

**THE ROLE**


**Cashmere Material Quality Lead**


**Summary:**



We are seeking a highly experienced Quality Assurance Lead specializing in cashmere and fine fibers. The role is crucial in ensuring our products meet the highest quality standards from raw fiber to finished goods, and in aligning quality initiatives with our brand strategy. You will lead a team, manage a testing center, and work closely with suppliers and internal teams to enhance quality practices.


**Responsibilities:**


* Define and implement quality standards across raw fiber, dehaired fiber, yarns, and finished goods.
* Establish and manage a testing center, including lab protocols for fiber fineness, length, color consistency, strength, pilling, and dye fastness.
* Analyze how each stage of the supply chain impacts final product quality, and design preventive measures.
* Build and lead a QA/QC team, providing training and development.
* Collaborate closely with sourcing, production, and design teams to align quality with brand strategy.
* Partner with suppliers and factories to elevate quality practices and ensure compliance with international standards.


**Qualifications:**


* Bachelor's degree or higher in Textile Engineering, Material Science, or related field.
* 8\+ years of experience in cashmere or fine fiber quality management, covering raw material through finished goods.
* Proven track record in establishing quality systems and laboratories.
* Strong leadership and team\-building skills.
* Familiarity with international testing standards (GB, ISO, ASTM).
* Excellent communication skills in English and Chinese; ability to work with suppliers in China and Mongolia.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to translate data into actionable improvements.

description:
Synthomer is a leading supplier of high\-performance, highly specialised polymers and ingredients that play vital roles in key sectors such as coatings, construction, adhesives, and health and protection – growing markets that serve billions of end users worldwide. Headquartered in London, UK and publicly listed there since 1971, we employ c.3,900 employees across our 5 innovation centres of excellence and more than 29 manufacturing sites across Europe, North America and Asia. Around 20% of our sales volumes are from new and patent protected products.

  

At our innovation centres of excellence in the UK, Germany, China, Malaysia and Ohio, USA we collaborate closely with our customers to develop new products and enhance existing ones tailored to their needs, with an increasing range of sustainability benefits. Since 2021, we have been proud holders of the London Stock Exchange Green Economy Mark, which recognises green technology businesses making a significant contribution to a more sustainable, low\-carbon economy.

*All’interno di uno dei poli produttivi più strategici della zona industriale di Filago (BG), Synthomer S.r.l. è specializzata nella produzione di lattici sintetici in emulsione acquosa di tipo NBR e SBR. Questi materiali sono alla base di numerose applicazioni: dalla carta ai tappeti, dalla moquette al tessuto non tessuto, fino agli articoli di gomma, nastri adesivi, guanti monouso e riutilizzabili.*

*Ma ciò che ci distingue davvero è il nostro impegno per un futuro più sicuro, sano e sostenibile. Per noi la tutela dell’ambiente, della salute e della sicurezza sul lavoro (SHE) non è un valore aggiunto: è parte integrante del nostro modo di fare impresa.*

*Lavoriamo ogni giorno per ridurre il nostro impatto ambientale, minimizzare il consumo di risorse naturali ed eliminare ogni possibile rischio per chi lavora con noi o utilizza i nostri prodotti.*

*Crediamo nel miglioramento continuo, nella forza delle idee e nella collaborazione tra persone diverse. Per questo ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo, dinamico e stimolante, dove ogni talento – indipendentemente da genere, età o background – può contribuire e crescere.*

*In linea con la nostra cultura aziendale, abbiamo introdotto accordi di II livello che supportano il benessere delle persone e favoriscono un sano equilibrio tra vita privata e professionale.*

*Siamo orgogliosi delle nostre certificazioni UNI ISO 9001, UNI ISO 14001, UNI ISO 45001, EMAS, WHP che testimoniano il nostro impegno concreto per la qualità, l’ambiente e la sicurezza.*

*Se cerchi un contesto in cui le tue competenze possono fare la differenza e le tue ambizioni trovare spazio per esprimersi, potresti essere la persona giusta per il nostro team.*

*La posizione è aperta a tutte le persone qualificate, indipendentemente da genere, età, orientamento sessuale, identità di genere, nazionalità, origine etnica, credo religioso, disabilità o qualsiasi altra caratteristica tutelata dalla legge.*

*I candidati/candidate disabili interessati/e al presente annuncio possono contattare l’ufficio HR sia per ottenere le necessarie informazioni in modalità compatibili con le proprie condizioni sia per fruire di specifica assistenza in occasione dell’eventuale colloquio/prova di selezione.*

**Finalità del ruolo**


Provvedere alle attività logistico\-produttive al fine di rispettare il programma di produzione pianificato, coordinando le proprie attività con quelle degli altri conduttori e delle altre funzioni aziendali (amministrazione, officine e laboratorio), al fine di garantire la massima efficienza dei lavori e il raggiungimento dei risultati comuni.

**Attività principali**


1\. Presidiare la sala quadri, l’andamento delle fasi del ciclo produttivo di NBR, SBR e dispersioni acriliche (preparazione manuale delle soluzioni, dosaggio, polimerizzazione, degasaggio e finitura) attraverso l’utilizzo del PLC, al fine di garantirne lo svolgimento in sicurezza e qualità. Rendicontare le attività e garantire piena continuità produttiva attraverso la compilazione del quaderno delle consegne.


2\. Eseguire la filtrazione prodotto finito mediante vibrovagli, al fine di ottenere le specifiche desiderate nel contenuto coagulo.


3\. Effettuare analisi chimiche di controllo (secco e ph) durante le fasi di lavorazione al fine di monitorare e garantire che la produzione rispetti gli standard qualitativi aziendali.


4\. Collaborare con capiturno e officine alla gestione degli impianti ausiliari di tutte le energie (es. raccolta e trattamento acque e rifiuti, caldaia e bruciatore, pompe vuoto, impianti acqua demi e gruppi frigo, compressori ecc.) al fine di garantire efficienza e sicurezza al ciclo produttivo. Segnalare guasti, anomalie e malfunzionamenti impiantistici al CT.


5\. Gestire un impianto di trattamento acque reflue (flocculazione) al fine di garantire gli standard ambientali previsti dall’azienda.


6\. Ricevere e provvedere allo scarico di materie prime liquide (es. butadiene ed acn) nei serbatoi di stoccaggio, materie prime imballate e materiale vario in ingresso (es. imballi, filtri, ecc.) attraverso l’utilizzo del carrello elevatore, al fine di garantire continuità al processo produttivo. Garantire una corretta gestione delle materie prime sia nella fase di prelievo che di effettivo utilizzo in produzione al fine di assicurare tutti gli aspetti di sicurezza e qualità all’interno del ciclo produttivo.


7\. Provvedere al carico del prodotto finito in bulk o in imballi (IBC e fusti), al fine di procedere all’evasione degli ordini dei clienti. Provvede al carico dei rifiuti o del materiale di scarto (es. B26, fusti, bancali ecc.), al fine della corretta gestione degli stoccaggi.


8\. Supportare il personale delle officine e delle ditte esterne in interventi di piccola manutenzione (bonifiche, cambio e pulizia filtri, guarnizioni, tubazioni in pressione, pompe, apertura e pulizia serbatoi, ecc.) al fine di garantire la massima efficienza e sicurezza dell’impianto. Provvedere laddove necessario ad attività di pulizia serbatoi con accesso in spazio confinato.


9\. Partecipare alle attività di formazione periodiche erogate dall’azienda e ottenere la qualifica di: primo soccorso, antincendio, carrello elevatore, spazi confinati, anticaduta e DPI 3° categoria secondo le prescrizioni legislative e aziendali previste.


Assicurare che lo svolgimento delle attività di competenza rispetti tutte le norme e le regole aziendali in ambito SHE al fine di raggiungerne la totale conformità e livello di pulizia ed ordine impianto (housekeeping, 5S). Gestire eventuali interventi critici di emergenza impianto (es. anomalie, allarmi, LOC, incendi, esplosioni); riportare ai diretti superiori eventuali deviazioni riscontrate in ambito process safety e SHE.

Turni a Ciclo Continuo. Le condizioni applicabili sono disciplinate dal CCNL di riferimento e dagli accordi aziendali vigenti.

description:
**Project Engineer**
====================

**Location:** Palazzo Pignano (CR)  

**Working Model:** This position is primarily based on\-site and it requires flexibility and willingness to travel, both within Italy and internationally, based on project needs.


At Fresenius Medical Care, we are the global leader in kidney care, committed to improving the quality of life of people living with chronic kidney disease. Our mission is to deliver innovative, high\-quality products, services, and care solutions across the entire healthcare continuum. Guided by our vision, *“Creating a future worth living. For patients. Worldwide. Every day.”*, we act with responsibility and dedication, supported by a global team of more than 110,000 employees.


Within our **Care Enablement** business segment, we develop and provide life\-sustaining medical devices, digital health solutions, and therapies that empower clinical teams and improve patient outcomes. Our **FME Reignite** strategy drives the transformation of our company through innovation, operational excellence, and sustainable growth.


Our values shape the way we work every day:

* We **care** for patients, people, and communities.
* We **connect** across borders and functions to achieve excellence together.
* We **commit** to doing the right thing, growing with purpose and leading kidney care through integrity and innovation.
**About the Role**


We are looking for a **Project Engineer** to join our Manufacturing Technology \& Industrialization team. In this role, you will lead and support international projects aimed at developing and implementing advanced production technologies for the efficient manufacturing of high\-quality medical devices and pharmaceutical products.


You will play a key role in driving innovation, optimizing production processes, and ensuring compliance with regulatory and quality standards across global manufacturing sites.

**Key Responsibilities**


As a Project Engineer, you will play a key role in the successful delivery of manufacturing and industrialization projects by:

* Leading technical projects from concept through implementation, ensuring performance, quality, cost, and timeline objectives are achieved.
* Managing project planning, budgeting, CAPEX requests, scheduling, and stakeholder coordination.
* Conducting feasibility studies, risk assessments, and technical evaluations to support strategic decision\-making.
* Driving process improvements to enhance productivity, quality, and operational efficiency.
* Ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, GMP standards, and internal quality systems.
* Developing and maintaining technical documentation, specifications, reports, and engineering drawings.
* Collaborating closely with Production, Quality, Maintenance, Procurement, Engineering, and Manufacturing teams.
* Acting as a key interface between Development, Manufacturing, and Value Stream organizations.
* Supporting validation activities and the implementation of new technologies and manufacturing processes.
* Identifying and resolving technical challenges throughout project execution and industrialization activities.

**What We're Looking For**

**Education \& Experience**
---------------------------

* Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, Process Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Minimum 2\-3 years of experience in a manufacturing environment.
* Proven experience managing engineering or industrialization projects.
* Solid background in production technologies and manufacturing processes.
* Experience within medical devices, pharmaceuticals, or other highly regulated industries is considered a strong advantage.
* Knowledge of GMP environments and Lean Manufacturing principles.

**Technical Skills**
--------------------

* Strong understanding of manufacturing technologies and industrial production processes.
* Experience with project management tools and methodologies.
* Proficiency in AutoCAD 2D (AutoCAD Inventor is a plus).
* Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.
* Intermediate English proficiency.
* SAP knowledge is an advantage.
* Familiarity with automation technologies, Siemens PLCs, motion control systems, pneumatic circuits, and electrical schematics is desirable.
* Knowledge of Minitab or similar statistical analysis tools is a plus.

**Personal Skills**
-------------------


We are looking for someone who combines technical expertise with a collaborative mindset and a passion for continuous improvement:

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work effectively in cross\-functional and international teams.
* Proactive, results\-oriented approach.
* Strong organizational and project coordination skills.
* Capacity to influence, engage, and inspire colleagues and project stakeholders.

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* The opportunity to work on strategic international projects within a global healthcare leader.
* Exposure to advanced manufacturing technologies and industrialization initiatives.
* A dynamic, collaborative, and multicultural work environment.
* Professional development and career growth opportunities.


The indicative annual base salary range for this position is between €32\.000 and €38\.000\.

**We are an equal opportunity employer.**  

We carefully and respectfully consider all applications, including those from individuals with disabilities (law 68/99\).  

We are committed to providing an inclusive work environment and, where needed, offering reasonable accommodations to ensure all candidates can participate in the selection process and, subsequently, perform their role.

title: Sr. Global Technical Consultant (f/m/d) Pharma & Personal Care
description:
At Ecolab, making the world a cleaner, safer place is our business. In the Life Sciences division, we are committed to providing complete solutions for the Pharmaceutical and Personal Care Industries. We achieve this by providing comprehensive solutions and technical know\-how focused on ensuring product quality and safety in cleaning, sanitation and contamination control while improving operational efficiency.


Ecolab is a company committed to growth and we believe that the role of Global Technical Consultant is one of the keys to our success in the Life Sciences division. As leaders in cleaning and disinfection, we are committed to driving business growth while providing individuals with a range of developmental career opportunities. The members of our team have an opportunity to help customers meet their goals, differentiate Ecolab from competition and impact achievement of growth targets.

**Position Purpose:**


The **Sr. Global Technical Consultant (GTC)** role is designed to work alongside customers at their facilities to identify improvement opportunities related to cleaning, disinfection, plant hygiene, driving value through improved product quality, employee and operational efficiency while ensuring regulatory compliance. This service is a key differentiator for Ecolab’s existing and potential customers.


The candidate will be expected to provide support/input for customers in the Personal Care and Pharmaceutical sectors related to cleaning and disinfection, application of Ecolab products and industry best practices. They will provide clean\-in\-place and clean\-out\-of\-place optimization through technical visits and site surveys. They will provide cleaning validation guidance and training to customers to ensure compliant cleaning processes once implemented. The role will also provide guidance to internal and external customers on “best practice” processes and products which can support these activities. The role is responsible for technically supporting the implementation of improvements and providing a link between customers and the internal sales teams.


This role will be Europe\-based but responsibilities may include liaising with customers and the sales team and traveling to international customer sites as needed.

**This is a remote role. Location in Italy.**

**Main Responsibilities:**

* Provide technical expertise to resolve complex customer problems across a broad base of Personal Care and Pharmaceutical manufacturing applications
* Conduct customer technical visits and site surveys, reviewing customer processes and the cleaning/disinfection products in place to ensure they are both compliant and efficient, making documented recommendations and supporting any changes
* Assist the customer in their change control process, which may include project management support, SOP guidance, and validation training
* Conduct customer\-facing seminars and internal training on GMPs, cleaning validation principles, cleaning \& disinfection best practices, and cleaning technologies
* Assist in communicating best practices and key learnings to the greater field sales organization
* Provide leadership on unique customer projects which are beyond the expected technical ability of Account Managers, Regional Managers, or Business Development Managers
* Ensure brand standards and awareness, accuracy and completion of final reports in a timely manner

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor of Science (BSc or equivalent) degree in Life Sciences, preferably with operations or engineering focus
* 10 years of practical experience in relevant industry
* Experience in understanding and troubleshooting of cleaning and CIP operations
* Ability to travel 50%\+ of time based on customer needs
* Excellent oral and written communication skills, interpersonal skills, and problem\-solving skills
* Valid driver’s license
* Ability to obtain Visas for International travel
* Fluent in English, Italian
* No immigration sponsorship available for this opportunity

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Master’s degree in Life Sciences field, preferably in Operations or Engineering
* Experience or familiarity with the Life Sciences industry (Pharmaceutical and/or Personal Care)
* Demonstrated proficiency with internal or external auditing
* Demonstrated project leadership and understanding of change control processes
* Ability to take initiative, work independently and prioritize multiple projects with strong follow\-through
* Flexibility to work on and control different projects at the same time while still meeting deadlines
* Previous experience in GMP production sites
* Fluent in English and Italian
* Understanding regulatory compliance frameworks (e.g. MHRA, FDA, HPRA)

**About Ecolab:**


At Ecolab, we prioritize our talent\-first philosophy by creating the most capable and diverse team to excel at our nearly three million customer sites. Building on a century of innovation, our 48,000 associates help deliver comprehensive science\-based solutions, data\-driven insights and world\-class service to advance food safety, maintain clean and safe environments, and optimize water and energy use, and improve operational efficiencies and sustainability for customers in the food, healthcare, life sciences, hospitality and industrial markets in more than 170 countries around the world. Our solutions not only enhance operational efficiency but also contribute to sustainability and public health, making a positive impact on the world. We are committed to eliminating unnecessary complexities and embracing a beginner's mindset, continuously seeking new perspectives and innovative solutions to stay ahead in a rapidly changing world.

*Ecolab’s commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion (DE\&I) reflects our longstanding value of working together to integrate diverse perspectives to challenge ourselves, reach our goals and do what’s right.*


Apply today and join one of the most ethical companies with over a hundred years of history.

**Join Ecolab and help us protect what’s vital.**


\#li\-eu

The annual total compensation range for this position is 63,800\-79,700\-95,700 which includes base pay and target incentive based on performance, per plan terms. **Benefits:**


Ecolab strives to provide comprehensive and market\-competitive benefits to meet the needs of our associates and their families.

 **Collective Agreement Information (Italy):**

In Italy, Ecolab applies the National Collective Labour Agreement for the Chemical Industry (CCNL Industria Chimica).

 **Our Commitment to a Culture of Inclusion \& Belonging**  

Ecolab is committed to fair and equal treatment of associates and applicants and furthering the principles of Equal Opportunity to Employment. We will recruit, hire, promote, transfer and provide opportunities for advancement based on individual qualifications and job performance in all matters affecting employment, compensation, benefits, working conditions, and opportunities for advancement. **Join Us as a Clinical Trial Coordinator – Make an Impact at the Forefront of Innovation**
===========================================================================================

**What You'll Do**
------------------

### **Clinical Trial \& Documentation Support**

* Coordinate and complete assigned clinical trial activities in accordance with the study task matrix.
* Perform Country and Investigator file reviews and document findings in the appropriate systems.
* Support audit and inspection readiness by ensuring study files are reviewed according to applicable schedules and procedures.
* Ensure assigned activities are completed on time and to a high\-quality standard, proactively communicating potential risks to project leads.
* Process and maintain clinical trial documentation within the electronic Trial Master File (eTMF).
* Review eTMF documentation and support the resolution of missing, incomplete, or outstanding documentation.
* Analyze findings reports and assist with the clarification and resolution of site documentation findings.
* Support the preparation, compilation, and distribution of Investigator Site Files (ISFs), pharmacy binders, and study supplies.
* Assist with study\-specific translations and translation quality control, as required.

### **Site Activation \& Regulatory Support**

* Provide administrative support for site activation and start\-up activities.
* Work with internal teams to help ensure site start\-up activities remain aligned with the site's activation critical path and project timelines.
* Support regulatory submissions and the tracking of local regulatory documentation.
* Transmit required documentation to clients and centralized Institutional Review Boards (IRBs)/Independent Ethics Committees (IECs), as applicable.
* Maintain accurate and timely records of site communications, contact attempts, follow\-ups, and survey responses.
* Review survey information to help ensure responses are complete, accurate, and relevant.
* Support effective site follow\-up plans and escalate concerns or potential risks appropriately.
* Liaise with relevant internal teams to support the timely resolution of investigator queries.

### **Systems \& Study Coordination**

* Provide support for clinical trial systems such as **Activate, eTMF**, and other study platforms.
* Help ensure study databases and systems remain accurate and up to date.
* Maintain study\-specific documentation, team lists, project training requirements, activity plans, and vendor trackers.
* Support Risk\-Based Monitoring (RBM) activities where applicable.
* Assist with scheduling internal and client meetings as required.
* Support study communications, including document distribution, reports, and project\-specific mailings.
* Collaborate closely with project team members to achieve targeted study milestones and deadlines.
* Communicate site\-related issues and potential risks to appropriate clinical and project colleagues.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

### **Minimum Qualifications**

* High school/secondary school diploma or equivalent relevant academic or vocational qualification.
* Additional university\-level education in **life sciences, healthcare, or a related discipline** is an advantage.
* Previous relevant experience may be beneficial; however, candidates who demonstrate the appropriate knowledge, skills, and motivation to develop within clinical research may also be considered.
* Equivalent combinations of education, training, and directly related experience may be considered.

### **Preferred Skills \& Experience**

* Strong organizational skills and excellent attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks efficiently while working to project deadlines.
* Ability to analyze project\-specific information and systems to ensure accuracy and completeness.
* Strong customer\-focused mindset.
* Flexibility and adaptability to changing priorities and study timelines.
* Interest in developing a strong working knowledge of **ICH\-GCP**, applicable Italian and European regulations, and clinical research procedures.
* Good written and spoken **English**, together with proficiency in the local language as required.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional and international teams.
* Good computer skills, including proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Ability to quickly learn and confidently work with clinical trial databases and systems.
* Good judgment, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills.
* Ability to follow study\-specific procedures and project instructions accurately.
* Ability to identify potential risks and escalate them appropriately.
* Self\-motivated with a positive and proactive approach to work.
* Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.

**Working Environment \& Travel**
---------------------------------


This position is primarily performed in an **office and/or home\-office environment**, depending on business requirements.

* Regular travel is not a core requirement of the role.
* Occasional travel or driving to clinical trial sites may be required depending on study needs.
* The position provides exposure to a wide range of clinical trial activities, systems, and cross\-functional teams, supporting continued development within clinical research.

**Why Join Thermo Fisher Scientific?**
--------------------------------------


When you join Thermo Fisher Scientific, you become part of a global team committed to accelerating scientific discovery and improving patient outcomes.


We offer:

* An excellent opportunity to **build and develop your career in clinical research**.
* Exposure to international clinical trials and global project teams.
* Hands\-on experience across site activation, regulatory documentation, clinical trial systems, and study management activities.
* A collaborative and inclusive environment where you can learn from experienced clinical research professionals.
* Continuous learning, professional development, and opportunities for career progression.
* Competitive compensation and benefits.
* The opportunity to contribute to clinical research that can make a meaningful difference in patients' lives.


If you're organized, detail\-oriented, motivated to learn, and excited about developing your career in clinical research, we'd love to hear from you.

**Apply today and help us deliver tomorrow's breakthroughs.**

description:
Part of the Wolters Kluwer’s CP \& ESG division, our award\-winning CCH® Tagetik expert solution provides the strategic \& financial intelligence platform that enables CFOs and their peers, in global enterprises, to propel their strategy with faster and better\-informed decisions. With embedded AI and state\-of\-the\-art governance, the open and extensible platform easily connects leading operational solutions to create enterprise\-wide insights, drive growth, and navigate change for our customers to gain the greatest value, today and tomorrow.

**Role Summary**
----------------


The **Director, SaaS Migration Program Execution**, will be responsible for overseeing the entire migration process for **Wolters Kluwer CCH Tagetik’s existing customer base**. This position will own the transition from legacy deployment and commercial models to the strategic cloud platform and the latest packaging and pricing models. Responsibilities include:

* Managing the migration of commercial models for cloud customers who are still using legacy models.
* Leading both the commercial and technical migration for on\-premise customers.


This role is accountable for converting migration strategy into operational execution, coordinating cross\-functional teams across Sales, Customer Success, Professional Services, Cloud Operations, Legal, Finance and Product.


The position requires a highly hands\-on leader capable of driving customer migrations at scale while managing complex customer\-specific situations, particularly within the on\-premise installed base where commercial, contractual, technical and organizational complexity is highest.


The role serves as the central point of accountability for migration outcomes, capacity planning, execution governance, risk management, and business value realization.

**Key responsibilities:**

**Migration portfolio management**

* Own the global SaaS migration portfolio, maintaining a consolidated view of all migration opportunities across customer cohorts and geographies.
* Translate migration strategy into executable annual and quarterly migration plans, customer migration waves and measurable business outcomes.
* Own customer prioritization, migration sequencing and cohort governance, continuously reassessing customer readiness, migration complexity and commercial opportunity throughout the migration lifecycle.
* Recalibrate migration priorities and customer cohorts based on new customer information, migration outcomes and changing business priorities.

**Migration program leadership**

* Lead execution of the global SaaS migration roadmap across all migration cohorts and regions.
* Establish and operate the Migration Execution Office as the central coordination function across Sales, Customer Success, Professional Services, Consulting Partners, Cloud Operations, Finance, Legal and Product.
* Orchestrate end\-to\-end execution across all participating functions, ensuring effective planning, dependency management, handovers and accountability throughout the migration process.
* Ensure migration execution remains aligned with strategic objectives, customer commitments, available capacity and financial targets.
* Drive consistent execution through standardized migration methodologies, operational playbooks, templates and governance processes.

**Migration governance \& performance management**

* Establish and facilitate the governance structure supporting the migration program including executive decision forums, operational reviews and performance reporting.
* Define, monitor and continuously improve migration KPIs, dashboards and reporting to provide transparency on migration progress, customer status, commercial outcomes, delivery performance and business case realization.
* Identify systemic bottlenecks, operational risks and recurring execution challenges, driving corrective actions across the organization.
* Own migration exception management, ensuring customer, commercial, contractual, technical and operational escalations are resolved efficiently and consistently.
* Ensure adherence to commercial guardrails, approval processes, pricing governance and migration policies.

**Capacity planning \& execution readiness**

* Define migration capacity requirements across Professional Services, Consulting Partners, Cloud Operations and supporting functions, balancing migration demand with available delivery resources.
* Ensure migration readiness across all participating functions prior to each migration wave, including resource availability, governance, customer preparation and operational planning.
* Provide executive recommendations on resource allocation, outsourcing opportunities, partner utilization and execution scalability.

**Customer migration execution**

**On\-premise customer migration (technical \& commercial)**

* Oversee end\-to\-end execution of commercial and technical migrations from customer qualification through technical assessment, commercial design, implementation, testing, product transition and post\-go\-live optimization.
* Coordinate cross\-functional delivery teams throughout the migration lifecycle while proactively resolving delivery risks and execution blockers.
* Ensure consistent execution quality across regions through standardized migration methodologies and operational standards.

**Cloud customer migration (commercial)**

* Lead the commercial migration program for existing cloud customers transitioning to the new packaging and pricing model.
* Partner with Sales and Renewal teams to execute structured, cohort\-based commercial migrations aligned to predefined customer lifecycle triggers such as renewals, cloud expansion opportunities and cross\-sell events.
* Balance customer retention, migration velocity, commercial standardization and ARR realization while ensuring compliance with commercial governance and negotiation guardrails.

**Continuous improvement**

* Capture lessons learned from completed migration waves and incorporate them into future migration planning, execution standards and governance processes.
* Continuously improve migration methodologies, planning assumptions, operational playbooks, reporting and customer engagement models.
* Drive increased standardization and scalability of migration execution while maintaining flexibility for strategic customer situations.
* Identify opportunities to automate, simplify and optimize migration processes across commercial and technical functions.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Minimum Bachelor’s in Engineering, Information Technology, Business or related field.
* 10\+ years of experience leading large\-scale transformation, cloud migration, SaaS transition or customer lifecycle programs.
* Demonstrated experience managing complex enterprise customer implementations and migrations.
* Strong program management, stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
* Proven ability to lead cross\-functional teams in a matrix organization.
* Experience driving operational execution across commercial, technical and services organizations.

**Preferred**

* Experience with enterprise software, SaaS business models or subscription transitions.
* Experience managing global customer transformation programs.
* Knowledge of cloud migration methodologies and enterprise application modernization.
* Familiarity with commercial transformation, pricing migrations and customer retention programs

**Critical success measures**

* Migration wave execution versus plan.
* On\-prem ARR converted to cloud ARR.
* Customer retention during migration.
* Migration cycle time and throughput.
* Delivery capacity utilization.
* Business case realization.
* Executive stakeholder satisfaction.


\#LI\-Hybrid

**Our Interview Practices**
---------------------------

*To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Humanitas Research Hospital is looking for an Animal Technician for the Immunology in Cardiovascular Pathologies Lab, to join the cardiovascular research team led by Gianluigi Condorelli. You will contribute directly to the quality of preclinical studies by combining animal care, experimental precision, and reliable management of samples and data.
  
  

This is an opportunity for someone who wants to grow in a multidisciplinary scientific environment, build specialist technical skills, and progressively gain greater autonomy, always in compliance with animal welfare standards, the 3Rs, and approved procedures.
  
  

Why this role
  
Work alongside researchers, veterinarians, and animal facility staff on preclinical cardiovascular studies.
  
Follow a structured training and mentoring pathway, with competency assessment before working independently.
  
Broaden your experience in in vivo procedures, perioperative monitoring, sample collection, and functional data, depending on project needs and authorizations.
  
Make a tangible contribution to animal welfare, study reproducibility, and the quality of the data generated.
  
What you will do
  
Monitor general condition, behavior, body weight, food and water intake, and other protocol\-defined parameters on a daily basis.
  
Apply score sheets, humane endpoints, and escalation criteria together with the designated veterinarian and study team.
  
Manage animal acclimatization, identification, handling, environmental enrichment, and traceability in line with internal procedures.
  
Prepare materials and equipment and support the pre\-, intra\-, and post\-procedural phases of cardiovascular studies within the scope of documented training.
  
Collect and manage biological samples and functional data, ensuring correct timing, labeling, and traceability.
  
Complete clinical records, experimental logs, and databases accurately and promptly.
  
Report anomalies or critical issues and contribute to the management of materials, equipment, SOPs, and operational checklists.
  
Who we are looking for
  
What matters most
  
A technical or scientific diploma, or a degree in biology, biotechnology, veterinary medicine, biomedical sciences, or a related discipline.
  
Practical experience, including internships, in an animal facility, preclinical laboratory, veterinary setting, or another regulated technical or scientific environment.
  
Basic knowledge of animal welfare, biosafety, SOPs, and the 3Rs, or strong motivation to develop this knowledge during onboarding.
  
Accuracy in following protocols and maintaining documentation, with confidence using records and digital tools.
  
Good reading comprehension of scientific English and willingness to complete the required training before working independently.
  
It would be an advantage to have
  
One to three years of experience in an animal facility or preclinical laboratory.
  
Experience with in vivo cardiovascular models and species relevant to the research programs.
  
Hands\-on experience with anesthesia and analgesia under supervision, perioperative monitoring, sampling, necropsy, or tissue collection.
  
Familiarity with cardiovascular endpoints, data acquisition software, LIMS/ELN systems, or facility databases.
  
  

Junior candidates with a relevant scientific background, good manual dexterity, and motivation to grow are encouraged to apply: you do not need to meet every preferred qualification. We are committed to equal opportunities throughout the selection process.
  
  

Skills you can contribute and develop
  
Low\-stress handling and clinical and behavioral monitoring of animals.
  
Preparation of sterile or aseptic setups, materials, medicines, and basic equipment.
  
Support for authorized procedures, supervised anesthesia and analgesia, recovery, and sample collection.
  
Accurate management of samples and data, with close attention to timing, labeling, archiving, and anomalies.
  
Progressive familiarity with physiological parameters, hemodynamic measurements, imaging, and other project\-specific cardiovascular endpoints.
  
How you work
  
You are reliable, precise, and attentive to detail.
  
You communicate clearly and enjoy working in a multidisciplinary team.
  
You can manage changing priorities while maintaining high standards of animal welfare, safety, and quality.
  
You work with ethical awareness, personal responsibility, and a willingness to learn.
  
What you will find
  
A multidisciplinary scientific environment and structured onboarding covering the facility, SOPs, biosafety, animal welfare, and technical procedures.
  
Hands\-on mentoring and progressive autonomy based on acquired competencies and authorized activities.
  
A one year fellowship, renewable up to a total maximum of three years; full\-time commitment with an expected start in October 2026\.
  
  

Send your CV and a brief cover note by 10 September 2026\. Tell us about any training you have completed, the species you have worked with, and the experimental techniques you know.
